current.title: Round 74 DELIVERED — the updater-freeze round (0.74.0)
current.detail: The owner's field report ('the installed desktop app version was 0.67.0 — it did not update') answered root-cause to remedy. (1) Root cause, proven against the live API: GitHub's /releases list sorts never-published DRAFTS above every published release — the R63-R67 close-outs left five drafts at positions 1-5 — and the launcher's first-match walk returned draft 0.67.0 as 'latest', so the installed 0.67.0 looked current while 0.73.0 was live (no error, nothing to see; it 'used to work' because in that era ALL releases were drafts). (2) The fix (launcher/acute_launcher.py, first launcher change since R63, ACUTE.bat byte-identical/CRLF-verified): NEW pure _pick_latest_release — walks every entry, picks the numerically greatest version (integer tuples: 0.10.0 > 0.9.0, 1.0.0 > 0.99.99), drafts first-class (owner PAT sees them), same-version tie prefers published, malformed entries skipped; _desktop_latest_release rewritten onto it (per_page 20→100, one retry, never-raise + dev-flow fallback byte-identical); the version-truth panel now NAMES the tag it picked and ACUTE.bat status annotates published/draft — the freeze is visible, not silent. (3) NEW launcher/tests/test_pick_latest_release.py — the repo's first Python suite (stdlib unittest, 10 tests incl. the exact owner-freeze list shape) wired into ci.yml's verify job AND release.yml's launcher-kit gate (github-release needs the kit job → every tag gated); kit assembly copies seven named files only, tests cannot leak into the zip. (4) Remediation: the five stale drafts published (releases 381461843/381577121/382282125/383173421/383247624, all HTTP 200 — the R69+ step those close-outs never got; non-destructive, reversible) — also un-freezing any pre-fix launcher (settled list carries v0.73.0 first); the never-downgrade guard verified to hold against every list state the old code could see. The fix reaches the owner via the launcher's own self-update (git pull → copy + re-exec). Anomaly flagged: v0.68.0 never existed (R68 skipped the tag push — the R61/R62 failure class; documented gap, superseded by 0.69.0+). Verification: root vitest 2558 unchanged and re-run green (2,546 + 12 e2e env-gated); launcher suite 10/10; py_compile, lint, typecheck clean; LIVE smoke — the real /releases JSON through the picker → 0.73.0 — run twice (orchestrator + the independent R74-b verifier, 9/9 PASS, verdict SHIP). Next: the R75 queue — delegate_task task_id/background/resume (the R73 deferral), plugin ctx enrichment (cline's appendContext seam), the lessons-ledger third consumer, ratings-driven tuning, the optional v0.68.0 backfill tag.
